mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness that triggers negative market reaction and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST < 1650 and RSAFS < 620000, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 285 indicates high inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, reducing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 285, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment levels (PAYEMS) signal strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1650 thousand units indicate residential sector weakness that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1650, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) below 19400 billion dollars and 1650 thousand units, respectively, signal broad economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 < 19400 and HOUST < 1650, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100 index) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
